subject.title: Workspaces: add Living Answers and action forms

question: Should bundled Workspaces widgets be allowed to turn workspace-authored form templates into operator-confirmed prompts sent to the active agent session?
rationale: The patch is intentionally bounded, but it still creates a durable authority boundary between agent-authored workspace content and `chat.send`; repository policy cannot determine that product and security ownership choice automatically.

options.title: Approve with explicit capability
options.body: Accept action forms only after the authority is named as a Workspaces capability, failure feedback is fixed, and focused security and browser proof cover the exact dispatch path.

options.title: Keep Workspaces display-only
options.body: Merge Living Answers separately and remove action-form prompt dispatch until maintainers define a broader action-capability contract.

options.title: Use approved custom widgets
options.body: Require interactive prompt submission to remain behind the existing approved custom-widget capability instead of adding a trusted built-in dispatch surface.

recommendation.title: Approve with explicit capability
recommendation.body: Accept action forms only after the authority is named as a Workspaces capability, failure feedback is fixed, and focused security and browser proof cover the exact dispatch path.

likelyOwner.reason: The direct mention and subscription are the strongest available signals for ownership of this security-sensitive product decision.
